_doc: Presentation-only. All live lighting and quality settings are authored here. No skill, UI, model or camera changes.

budgets._doc: iPad budgets, checked by tests (tests/core/asset-budget.test.js, tests/browser/open-world.mjs). Measured 29 October 2026 after the size pass: frames up to 1.37M triangles / 348 draw calls, maps 85.5 / 30.7 / 60.6 MB. Raise a number only with the owner's agreement; first shrink the new content (AGENTS.md, iPad budgets).

graphics._doc: Settings menu choices (src/ui/graphics-settings.js). The custom preset ('ปรับแต่งเอง') picks each quality field from these lists; anti-aliasing is its own setting for every preset (multisampled scene target, 0 = off). pixelRatio is drawn pixels per CSS pixel, capped by the screen's own.

post._doc: Screen grade (src/render/post.js). Tints are display colours; 50% grey is neutral. hazeStart is the screen height (0 bottom, 1 top) where the fog-coloured haze begins.
